headline: China Faces Deflation Crisis; Hsieh Chin-ho: If Nothing Changes, the Next Decade Will Be Even Harder - Liberty Finance
summary: China's Ministry of Finance announced it will inject 360 billion yuan into eight state-owned financial institutions. A Cai Xin Media chairman said the effect of the large-scale injections may be limited.
why: State-owned financial institutions are core lenders in China, and capital injections strengthen their balance sheets and lending capacity.
why_moved: The Ministry of Finance is directly adding capital to eight state-owned financial institutions, a measure that can bolster their capital positions and lending capacity.
